name: Children Leaving Their Parents
overview: Scripture teaches that children are called to leave their parents and cleave to their spouse, establishing a new, unified family as seen in Genesis 2:24. This transition is grounded in a foundation of respect and discipline; Proverbs emphasizes the importance of training and correcting children so they grow in wisdom and bring delight to their parents (Proverbs 13:24; 22:6; 29:15,17). Deuteronomy 27:16 warns against disregarding parental authority, underscoring the biblical mandate for honoring parents even as children move into their own households.
